title: mentha longifolia subsp. calliantha
intro: Mentha longifolia subsp. calliantha, commonly known as Hoary Bergamot, is a subspecies of mint native to the Mediterranean region. This herb is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of digestive issues, such as bloating and indigestion, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hoary Bergamot are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents of Mentha longifolia subsp. calliantha include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
